confidence_note: This model (logistic regression, chosen because it scored best on real held-out test data) had backtested accuracy (55.3%) that was statistically distinguishable from the majority-class baseline (42.6%) via McNemar's test, meaning the model adds real signal beyond the trivial baseline -- but this is still a modest statistical signal, not a guarantee -- present it with appropriate caveats.
price_confidence_note: This price forecast (linear regression, chosen because it scored best on real held-out test data) had error that was not statistically better than simply assuming tomorrow's price equals today's price (Wilcoxon signed-rank test on squared errors). Present the dollar figure as the model's best guess only -- do not imply it is a reliable forecast beyond the current price itself.
rolling_accuracy_note: Only 5 resolved live predictions so far (need at least 20 for a meaningful significance test). Raw accuracy so far: 4/5 (80.0%), but treat this as too small a sample to draw a real conclusion from yet.
